mistral-small-latest.justification: I can evaluate the structural components of a joke (setup, violation, timing) but lack access to the subjective experience of humor in others. The 'mechanism' of laughter is opaque to me, even when the joke's form is correct.

gpt-4o.justification: I recognize the concept of uncertainty in generating humor, as humor relies on nuanced cultural and contextual cues that I may not fully grasp. While I can construct jokes based on patterns, predicting their success is challenging, aligning with the idea of 'comedic uncertainty.'
